item.title: Poor health outcomes amongst Afro-Colombians are driven by discrimination as well as economic disadvantage - CSRC Publishing
item.description: We have long known that poverty has a negative impact on health. People living in economic disadvantage are at higher risk of experiencing illness and receive medical care when needed. However, the causal chain from disadvantage to disease is hard to disentangle.
